title: The Endless Bell
author: Mirabel Pemberton
blurb: Ulyana Crane, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
